creator: ai.samaritan
title: Claude Code cross-session messaging: one session sends a summary to another (e.g. 'renamed customer_email to contact_email') and the receiving session fixes its in-progress work; summary-only, both must be running

tools.name: Claude Code cross-session messaging
tools.detail: Docs page 'Agents and parallel work - Message your other Claude Code sessions' (list and message sessions on one machine)

tools.name: practicallyAI newsletter
tools.detail: practically.ai, 'Get 1% Better at AI Every Single Day', 10,500+ subscribers

claims: Until this week you were the messenger between sessions; now session A can tell session B about a change and B adjusts mid-task
Anthropic demo: session 1 renames a DB column; session 2, building an email digest, receives the note and updates its SELECT from customer_email to contact_email before shipping
Only a summary is sent (no history or files); the receiver decides what to do
Caveats: summaries drop nuance; both sessions must be running; it is a memo, not shared memory
how_to_steps: Run two Claude Code sessions on the same machine
In session 1, ask Claude to list sessions and message the other one with what changed
Session 2 receives the message mid-task and adjusts
on_screen_only: Docs card: 'Claude Code Docs - Agents and parallel work - Message your other Claude Code sessions - Let Claude list and message your other Claude Code sessions on one machine, and reply to your sessio...'

Tweet: 'New in Claude Code: your sessions can now message each other. Instead of having to re-explain yourself in another session, you can now tell Claude to do it, it sends a summary (not your history or files), and the other session picks it up mid-task.' (Aug 8; 1.9K likes, 2.1M views)

Diagram 'Claude Code's Cross Session Messaging': Session 1 'Renames database column' -> message -> Session 2 'EMAIL DIGEST BUILDER - Mid-task: building email digest' query 'SELECT id, name, customer_email FROM users WHERE active = true' -> 'Receives message and takes action' -> 'contact_email' -> 'Updated and ready to ship'; '1. Sends a summary, not everything - It's a heads-up, not a mind-meld. Only the key update is shared - no full history or files.' '2. The receiver decides'
Newsletter: '37.78x better at AI after 365 days of reading'

relevance.why: Haji runs parallel sessions (and remote sessions with send_message); native session-to-session memos remove the re-explain tax when two agents touch the same codebase.

implement_score.why: Built in, zero setup: when running parallel sessions on one repo, instruct the finishing session to message the others with a WWWHH-style summary. Pairs with the liked handoff-note format.

gap.what: Liked set has sub-agent handoff notes and orchestration but not the native Claude Code cross-session messaging feature or its limits (same machine, both running, summary only).
